This '''clone sergeant''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] participated in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]] under the command of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and, following the conclusion of the conflict on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] received orders from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] to follow [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Have some men protect the ships. The rest of you - encircle the clearing. Prepare to sweep the jungle.|Anakin Skywalker gives orders to the sergeant|<ref name="CW17" />}}
This [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] was one of the many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] created on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] based on the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] with the purpose of serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a soldier. Following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] fought in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], an engagement which he survived and which was won by the Republic. Shortly after the battle, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] flew above the city of [[Harnaidan]] in her [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|Ginivex-class starfighter]] while being followed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], passing over the sergeant and numerous other clones stationed in the city along with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. After Skywalker refused to break pursuit of the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]], the Jedi Master ordered the clone sergeant and his platoon to follow the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. He and his men executed the order, leaving [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] immediately in a [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 troop carrier]].<ref name="CW11">{{CW|11}}</ref>

A short time after Skywalker landed on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and searched for Ventress, the clones' troop carrier landed next to the ''[[Azure Angel]]'' and the sergeant, along with his troops, fanned out of the ship. He ordered his platoon to secure the surroundings before Skywalker met with them at the landing site and called out the sergeant. He stood at attention as he saluted the Jedi Padawan, who asked him if he had been given orders by Kenobi to follow him. The sergeant confirmed this as Jedi grew annoyed with his Master. Nevertheless, Skywalker told him to have some men look after their ships and to take the rest to sweep the jungle for Ventress. The clone complied and followed his Jedi [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the search for the assassin.<ref name="CW17" />

However, as the sergeant and the rest of the platoon spread out to cover a larger area, Ventress killed him and the others one by one before destroying their ship, as well as Skywalker's, and attacking the Jedi.<ref name="CW17" />

==Equipment==
This clone trooper sergeant wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]] and brandished a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="CW17" />
